#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<int> cuts;
vector<vector<int>> memo;

int solve(int idx, int cap) {
    if (idx == 0 || cap == 0) return 0;
    if (memo[idx][cap] != -1) return memo[idx][cap];
    int cost = cuts[idx - 1];
    int best;
    if (cost <= cap) {
        best = max(1 + solve(idx - 1, cap - cost), solve(idx - 1, cap));
    } else {
        best = solve(idx - 1, cap);
    }
    memo[idx][cap] = best;
    return best;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n, w;
    cin >> n >> w;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) even++;
        else odd++;
        if (even == odd) {
            cuts.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    
    int m = cuts.size();
    memo.assign(m + 1, vector<int>(w + 1, -1));
    
    cout << solve(m, w) << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}
